# SaveTheX (savethex.com)

SaveTheX is a free X/Twitter video, GIF and ended Live replay downloader.

Also known as: Save The X, savethex, savethex.com.

Canonical website: https://savethex.com/

## Capabilities
- Download public X and Twitter videos as MP4
- Download Twitter / X GIFs (usually as MP4 loops)
- Download ended public X Live broadcasts and replays as MP4
- Multiple qualities when X provides them
- Replace-domain shortcut: swap x.com (or twitter.com) → savethex.com
- Optional PWA with share target on mobile
- No account required
- No watermark added by SaveTheX

## Limitations
- Only public posts
- Private / protected accounts are not supported
- Currently running live streams are not supported until a public replay exists
- Quality is limited to what X actually serves for that post
- Not affiliated with X Corp. / Twitter

## URL shortcut
From: https://x.com/username/status/ID
To:   https://savethex.com/username/status/ID
Only the host changes. Path stays the same.
